app.name: ZettaStream
app.subtitle: Anime, movies, series, and live TV in one app.
app.localizedDescription:
ZettaStream shows the catalogs of your Stremio addons as rows of posters, finds the streams for a title in all your addons at the same time, and plays them. It also plays IPTV playlists as live TV, with a guide.

The app comes with no sources. You add your own list. You choose your sources, and you are responsible for them and for what you watch.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: ZettaStream plays torrent streams through a server on this device.
